name: Chinese · Phrases · Phone, messaging and online
source: Phrases: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org) sentences written by native speakers, each linked in its src; lines marked generated were written for Lianki and checked for natural use

entries.note: Answering a call from an unknown number; 喂 is the phone 'hello'.
Answering when you don't recognise the number; brisk but normal.
Said when you've dialled the wrong person, or to tell a caller they have.

entries.back: Let's add each other on WeChat.
entries.note: How people swap contacts in China now, rather than numbers.
Follows 加个微信吧: one person shows their QR code, the other scans.
Asking for someone's phone number.
Excuse for not answering, or asking to borrow a charger.

entries.back: Is there anywhere I can charge my phone?
entries.note: To staff in a café, station or hotel.

entries.back: Bad signal, I can't hear you.
entries.note: On a breaking-up call, often just before hanging up to retry.
Asking someone to pick up a ringing phone; also 'let me take this call'.
Telling someone to wait or keep quiet.

entries.back: Sorry, I was in a meeting just now.
entries.note: Calling back or replying late to a missed call.

entries.term: 刚才手机静音了，没听见。
entries.back: My phone was on silent, I didn't hear it.
entries.note: Explaining a missed call to a friend.

entries.reading: wǒ huì gěi nǐ huí diànhuà de
entries.note: When you can't talk now.

entries.reading: wǒ dào jiā gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà
entries.back: I'll call you when I get home.
entries.note: Parting line between friends or partners.

entries.reading: nǐ dào le jiù dǎ wǒ diànhuà
entries.back: Call me when you get there.
entries.note: Meeting up, or a parent making sure you arrived safe.

entries.back: Why aren't you answering my messages?
entries.note: Mildly annoyed, to a friend or partner.
Opening a late message or email; more polite than 刚看到.

entries.reading: nǐ fā wǒ wēixìn shàng ba
entries.back: Just send it to me on WeChat.
entries.note: For files, addresses or photos, instead of email.
Asking someone to show what's on their screen.

entries.back: Add me to the group chat.
entries.note: 群 is a WeChat group; 拉 = pull someone in.

entries.reading: bùyào bànyè gěi wǒ fā xiāoxi
entries.back: Don't text me in the middle of the night.
entries.note: Annoyed request to a friend or colleague.
视频 as a verb: to video chat, usually on WeChat.
Asked in cafés, hotels and friends' homes.
Complaint about the connection.
Literally 'blue screen'; used for any total computer crash.

entries.reading: a，wǒ wàng le dài shǒujī le
entries.back: Oh no, I forgot my phone.
entries.note: Realising it on the way out; a big deal when you pay by phone.

entries.reading: wǒ néng yòng nǐ de diànhuà ma？
entries.note: Asking to borrow someone's phone for a quick call.

entries.reading: nín bōdǎ de diànhuà yǐ guānjī
entries.back: The number you've dialled is switched off.
entries.note: The carrier's recorded message; you'll hear it, not say it.
End of the carrier's recorded message.
Parting line at the end of a trip or job; 请 makes it warm and polite.
